title: Chapter 850
paragraphs: Chapter 850
Episode 211. Orgal's Negotiation (4)
Phaelito looked down at the fallen Orgal and shrugged his shoulders.
[I almost died there.]
He was talking to himself, not Orgal. If he had killed Orgal just then, Phaelito would have been executed by Zito.
'I didn't expect Orgal to be already dead... What ability is he using to deny death? It's not the power of the Sun God or the witch since it's blocked by Vascaline.'
He felt somewhat uncomfortable.
The Orgal that Phaelito remembered was always like that from the old times. His power or abilities were not very strong, but he always had something that made his opponent uncomfortable.
'The use of red power was also the same, still a mysterious figure. But if Lord Zito learns that he is already dead, the succession structure may change.'
Phaelito slowly moved towards the rift in the magical barrier. From before, the energy of the magical barrier has been creating an uncomfortable feeling of pressuring and pulling him.
However, this terrible sensation wouldn't last much longer. The demons of the underground were finally preparing to rise to the surface and dominate it.
Phaelito threw himself into the abyss beneath the rift. After a rather long period of freefall, a dazzling light was reflected in his eyes.
His body felt as if it was burning. To ascend through the rift of the magic barrier, one had to pass through the 'artificial sun'.

Now, only those who could withstand the horrific heat of the artificial sun could cross over the rift of the magic barrier. Once the curse on the magic barrier is completely lifted, they would be able to ascend to the surface beyond the intermediate world.
As the heat of the artificial sun started to fade, the familiar landscape of the underworld appeared. Phaelito, who landed in a plain of the demon world, headed straight for the Sword Demon Castle.
"Have you arrived, Lord Phaelito?"
"Sakiel, is Lord Zito awake now?"
"He just entered recovery. It might be better to postpone your report."
"That might be best. I've just met Orgal in the intermediate world."
"Was he following Lord Zito's will?"
"No, just like the witch said. He still wants the revival of the Sun God. He even threatened that he would go to war if we invade the surface."
"He's still insolent."
"He's indeed someone who has the right to be so."
"Do you have any other information about the surface?"
"None. We should deal with the witch before the transition to find out more."
"We already have a rough understanding of the power structure and the situation of important individuals, so I wonder if it's worth taking the risk of dealing with the witch."

"That will ultimately be a decision for Lord Zito to make. Meanwhile, I do want to cross swords with that Chiron Runcandel. A man who even the witch admires... It's unimaginable if we're talking about the humanity we know. The birth of such a person."
"Chiron Runcandel is wandering in the witch's territory now, wouldn't he be unable to return to humanity?"

"He's a person who has transcended fate, so it's an unknown territory. Part of the witch's realm is connected to the underground, so we might see him here, not necessarily as a human, since they are all regions where transition is impossible."
Transition.

The demons of the demon world were preparing to lift most of the underground world to the surface. They plan to send all the lands to the surface, except for some areas that overlap with the witch's realm. They did not plan to base their operations in the intermediate world like the enemy race.
"That's possible. But it's strange, why is a person with no interest in the revival of the Sun God so obsessed with the witch's territory..."

"Well, it could simply be a struggle to become stronger, or the witch may have other information that she has not told us. Either way, it's a pity that we won't be able to meet him as soon as we ascend to the surface."
"Still, there are a few individuals who can quench your thirst, Lord Phaelito, so don't be too disappointed."

"They will be less affected by Vascara, so they won't be as bland as Orgal. No, I should consider fighting without Vascara in the first place. If it ends as vainly as this time, I'll just want to kill them all."
Phaelito and Sakiel climbed the walls of the Sword Demon Castle. The cityscape, which was faintly shimmering in the light of the artificial sun, came into view.
Imagining the real sun shining on them, Sakiel wiped away a tear for a moment with a choked up heart. Phaelito gave him a handkerchief with a snicker.
"I'm sorry for my ugly appearance."
"It happens. Is there any news from the enemy race's riff-raff yet?"
"No, they don't seem to have noticed the rift yet. They must be distracted by the war with the Zipple. But they'll notice soon."

"Let me know immediately if they get close to the rift. Although they are said to be ruined and buried, they still hold the core technology and abilities to revive the Sun God. We cannot let the Sun God wake up because of those wretches."
"Understood, Lord Phaelito."
The moment the two of them finished their conversation, a demon urgently sought Phaelito.
"Lord Phaelito!"
"What is it?"
"Basset's army is currently attacking Lord Dailerus's castle, they've requested assistance."
"Ho, it seems Basset has already recovered from the wound I gave him last time. Open the door, I'll go immediately."
"Invincible, huh... Huh? Zephyrin?"
"What's up, Devil Dragon. Why are you acting so suddenly?"
All of a sudden, Zephyrin was sweating cold sweat and shaking. Jin sensed that something had happened to Orgal.
"Something seems to have happened to Orgal."
Zephyrin took a moment to catch his breath, then honestly shared the news.
"...Yes, Lord Jin. It seems the negotiation has failed."
"Beyond that, didn't Orgal get attacked? Judging by your condition, it seems like you've taken quite a hit."
"He nearly died."
"...What? Orgal?"
Jin and Murakan did not know the exact combat power of Orgal.
However, it was certain that he was currently one of the strongest in humanity. Moreover, with various powers at his disposal, it was hard to imagine Orgal being in a life-threatening situation.
"Devil Dragon, are the demons of the underground that strong?"

"Generally, they are similar to humans. Just as not all humans are the same, there are a few in the underground that are very strong. Of course, each of the underground demons are not at a level that can be compared to ordinary humans... and their technology also surpasses that of the surface in some respects, like the enemy race."
"You're spilling information freely. Do you want to form a temporary alliance with us again because of the underground forces?"

"That's not for me to decide. And whether we form a temporary alliance or not. When the underground demons start to move in earnest, the Vamel Alliance will inevitably feel burdened. And we've typically been more open with Lord Jin when it comes to sharing information. That's what's frustrating."
"According to Lady Ameris, the losers of the ancient times were the enemy race and the Blue race. But are the underground demons more dangerous than the enemy race?"

"The reason you were able to intimidate the enemy race, Lord Jin, was because they were not as strong as they were then. The current enemy race has no god, and their manpower and resources are not comparable to those times. But that's not the case with the underground demons."
The underground demons are fully intact.
They had lived in the world under the demon seal wall all along, unlike the enemy race, the Blue race, or other demons who had escaped from the demon realm, without being sealed and buried.

Or you could say they had survived. There had been constant wars in the demon world during that long period. It was only recently that Zito regained consciousness and was on the verge of unification, but not all forces resisting Zito had disappeared.
Zephyrin didn't know all of that. He had only recently retrieved the ancient memory. But he could guess right away that 'unification by Zito' was imminent.
After all, Orgal nearly died while trying to negotiate.

"The fact that my master faced a near-death experience means that the demons who have come out of the rift now are likely to be Zito's servants. If they were demons wishing for the resurrection of the sun god, they would have had no reason to clash with my master. It means Zito holds the hegemony of the underworld now."
"Then... when those demons of the underground stretch their wings, the first thing they would do is settled."
At Jin's words, Zephyrin nodded.
"Yes, they would surely try to reclaim Zito's eye, which is being held by the Holy Kingdom."
This means that a second Holy Kingdom Defense War could occur in the world shortly. Jin paused for a moment in thought.

'The key is how powerful Zito and the demons of the underworld are. But no matter how strong they are, it's hard for the great forces on the ground to form a temporary alliance like during the Evil God War. Gipell is already at war with the enemy race.'
Somehow, Jin had the feeling that Gipell had a higher chance of joining hands with the demons of the underworld or the enemy race.
Then, all that was left was the Vamel Alliance and Kinzelo.

Zephyrin was already considering an alliance and continuing the conversation. Otherwise, there was no reason to divulge so much information. Even if not an alliance, it was almost certain that Kinzelo was in a situation where it needed the help of the Vamel Alliance.

'After all, if the demon called Zito is truly a madman trying to rule the world with pain, he is indeed a public enemy. Even if not a temporary alliance, it would be good for us to appropriately use Kinzelo and prepare.'
While thinking, a commotion came from outside.
Orgal had just returned to the new headquarters. When he went outside, he saw a crumpled steel door and Orgal being propped up by the members.
[Jin Runcandel...]
"Orgal, I heard a rough story from Zephyrin just now. You seem to have been nicely beaten by the demons of the underworld."
[The match was not good.]

"Oh, is that so? But Orgal, it seems to me that you didn't escape by your own power... Somehow, it seems you were able to return alive by receiving mercy. Don't tell me you made some deal with the underworld?"
Jin just threw out the words, but Orgal told the truth without any hesitation.
[Zito, he wants to make me his successor. That's why I was able to live.]
